mainEntity.name: Is Julius AI built on ChatGPT?

acceptedAnswer.text: Julius AI uses LLMs and wraps them in data-analysis workflows; ChatGPT is a general assistant with optional advanced data analysis tools.

mainEntity.name: Which is better for CSV and Excel exploration?

acceptedAnswer.text: Julius AI is usually faster for one-shot file exploration with charting and notebook-like outputs.

mainEntity.name: Which is better for custom prompting and broad tasks?

acceptedAnswer.text: ChatGPT is generally better for a wide range of writing, coding, and reasoning tasks beyond file analysis.
No. ChatGPT can accelerate analysis but still needs governed models, metric definitions, and reproducible pipelines for production BI.

mainEntity.name: What about data privacy and compliance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both can be safe with enterprise controls, but you should evaluate retention, training policy, data region, and SOC 2 commitments before uploading sensitive files.
